annotations.title: Add a column to a track's sheet

description: Adds a column of the sheet's own after its last one, for the sheet's formulas or the answers to its questions to fill (a Category the sheet asks about, a Status). TrackerHacker leaves it alone: hacks don't write it. For a column hacks should fill, publish a new version of the track's schema instead (publish_schema).
name: add_column
title: Add a column to a track's sheet
